arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && cat scratch/report.md && echo "---" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
s=open('scratch/report.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
lines=s.split('\n')
out=[];inside=False
for l in lines:
    if re.match(r'^##\s',l):
        if inside: break
        if l.strip()=='## 风险': inside=True; continue
    if inside: out.append(l)
open('scratch/risk.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(out).strip())
EOF
echo "=== risk.txt ==="; cat scratch/risk.txt; echo "=== end ==="; md5sum scratch/report.md
arguments.label: Extract risk section
